prose: The Financial Times reports that Alibaba, Tencent, and Huawei are pouring billions of dollars into data centers in Shaoguan, a hinterland region of China with cheap power and a cool climate, angering some local residents. The article is paywalled and could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline reporting.
highlights: Alibaba, Tencent, and Huawei investing billions in Shaoguan data centers
Draw: cheap power and a cool climate in a hinterland region
Some locals are angered by the build-out
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the FT article is paywalled and the fetch returned an error.
